Nothing about this is stored under `project:lm`, and there is no memory for the exact name "ai-llm-proxy". What exists is global-scope memory from project `ae`:

- **GigaCode raw model (tested live 2026-08-27, CLI 26.7.33):** first POST to `https://gigacode.ru/api/v2/auth/plugin` with JSON `{device_code: <~/.gigacode/device_id>, plugin_name:"cli-plugin", plugin_version:"26.7.33", env_name:"linux", login, locale}`. It returns a JWT `access_token` that lasts only 600 s, so `~/.gigacode/gigacode_token.json` is usually expired. Then POST `https://gigacode.ru/api/v2/chat/completions` with `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and `model:"vllm/CodeChat"`, the only model (listed in `GET /api/v2/config` under `chat.models`; `/api/v2/models` returns 404). The format is plain OpenAI; streaming and tool calls work.
- **GigaCode pitfalls:** the response has a `reasoning_content` field but it was always null. Calling twice within a couple of seconds returns plain-text `Too Many Requests`, not JSON. The GigaCode path has no thinking or effort setting; the `reasoning.effort` code in the CLI bundle belongs to the Anthropic generator inherited from qwen-code.
- **The closest proxy is `ai-dev-proxy`:** `https://ai-dev-proxy.k8s.n3.2gis.io` with endpoints `/chat/completions`, `/models` and `/v1/user/models`. The auth key is OPK from `~/.config/opk.env` (the same value as `GIS_OPK` in the bridge). `local-coding-medium` and `coding-medium` map to `internal/internal-deepseek-v4`, which is really DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on sglang with `--reasoning-parser deepseek-v41`. On 2026-09-22 and again on 2026-09-27 that model returned 401 "Ошибка авторизации" ("authorization error") because the proxy's auth to the internal upstream was broken, not the key. The workaround is `coding-large`, `coding-large-next` or `coding-medium-next`.
- **Not found:** memory holds nothing specific on how DeepSeek thinking is sent or configured through the proxy, beyond the `deepseek-v41` reasoning parser.
